# [pump_alloc] pump_alloc

## Description

The allocation `pump_alloc` of TC-197 fixture Y: the operation `Pump/run`
allocated to the part `sys_pump`. It is qualified into `Pump` (source
end-owner) and `Sys` (target end-owner) and resolves as the member owned by
`Pump`.

## Allocation

| Source | Target |
|---|---|
| Pump/run | sys_pump |
